name: Restaurant 360
tier: THE GRAND TABLES — ON THE WALLS, THE ROOF AND THE SEA
recognition: One MICHELIN star in the MICHELIN Guide Croatia 2026; Gault&Millau Croatia 2026 18/20 (four toques, joint highest with NAV, Zagreb); La Liste 2026 75 points
reservation: Required; book weeks ahead for the wall tables in season
notes: The long tasting menu, taken on the wall terrace at sunset
verdict: The grand night on this coast, and the one booking to make first. The cooking is precise rather than loud, and the setting does half the work. It is also the house most exposed to the calendar and the wind: it runs a spring-to-autumn season and a Jugo can move dinner indoors. Book the wall tables, accept the price, and check it is still trading before you promise it to guests late in the year.
caveat: Seasonal and dinner only, closed Mondays; 2026 closing date not published in what we found, so call before promising it after mid-October

name: Stara Loža (Prijeko Palace)
tier: THE BERTHS · THE GRAND TABLES — ON THE WALLS, THE ROOF AND THE SEA
recognition: Listed in the MICHELIN Guide Croatia 2026 (Mediterranean, €€€€, rooftop terrace); in the guide since 2017 per In Your Pocket
what_to_order: Chef's market menu|Mali Ston oysters|Sea bass in salt crust|Croatian wine from the cellar
notes: The chef's market menu on the rooftop
verdict: Prijeko is the street of menu-touts, and this is the address on it that a guide can send people to without apology. Go for the rooftop, which is small and books out, and treat the street terrace as a fallback. The cooking is careful rather than daring. The hotel shut from early January to the end of February in 2026, so winter plans need a call.
caveat: Rooftop is tiny; book well ahead. Hotel listings show a winter closure (2 Jan–28 Feb in 2026)

name: Nautika
tier: THE GRAND TABLES — ON THE WALLS, THE ROOF AND THE SEA
recognition: Gault&Millau Croatia 2026: 16.5/20, 'Remarkable Restaurant'; listed in the MICHELIN Guide Croatia 2026 (classic cuisine, €€€€)
what_to_order: Lobster bisque|Whole turbot|Soufflé glacé Grand Marnier
price_range: MICHELIN €€€€; one guide puts the tasting menu at about EUR 150–200 before drinks (undated, seen Oct 2026)
reservation: Essential for the sea terrace; book well ahead
notes: Lobster bisque, then the whole turbot carved at the table
verdict: The safe grand dinner: white tablecloths, set pieces done properly, a view that sells itself. It does not try to surprise, and at these prices some guests will want it to. For a principal who wants the classic Dubrovnik evening without a tasting-menu marathon, this is the booking. Check the season: listings put it on a spring-to-October calendar.
caveat: Book the sea terrace two weeks ahead; season appears to end around late October, call before planning November

name: Proto Fish Restaurant
tier: THE BERTHS · THE OLD HOUSES INSIDE THE WALLS
recognition: Fish house since 1886; Gault&Millau Croatia 2026 14.5/20; in the MICHELIN Guide selection (fish and seafood, €€€)
what_to_order: Grilled sea bass on the bone|King prawns na buzaru|Ston oysters|Crni rižot
reservation: Book about a week ahead for the terrace in season; easier in winter
notes: Grilled sea bass on the bone, with crni rižot to start
verdict: The reliable fish dinner inside the walls, and in late autumn one of the few that is certain to be open. Expect the classics cooked properly rather than any surprise, and prices set for the Stradun. Ask for the terrace at lunch; the indoor rooms are better than they look from the lane. Good choice for a crew night out or a last-minute table this week.
caveat: Winter hours differ by source (see hours); January holiday break reported

name: Kopun
tier: THE OLD HOUSES INSIDE THE WALLS
recognition: Falstaff Restaurant Guide Croatia 2026: 86 points; capon is the highlight, vegetarian dishes also praised
price_range: Mains about EUR 25–45 (German guide, undated, seen Oct 2026)
reservation: Book a few days ahead for the square terrace
notes: Kopun: capon slow-cooked with orange and honey
verdict: Worth the climb for dishes the rest of the Old Town does not cook, and the square is quieter than the streets below it. Order the capon and the šporki makaruli and skip the international side of the menu. Mid-priced for the walls. Winter opening is not confirmed in what we found, so call before building a November plan around it.
caveat: Winter schedule not confirmed; most Old Town houses close for part of the winter
hot_this_month: Držić's capon with oranges and honey suits the first cool evenings; the house also lists šporki makaruli and arancini (checked 22 Oct 2026).

name: Lady Pi-Pi
address: Disputed: Antuninska 23 (Time Out) / Peline 25-b (corner.inc) / Peline 1 (old record), Old Town, 20000 Dubrovnik
tier: THE OLD HOUSES INSIDE THE WALLS
recognition: Charcoal grill on a vine terrace under the north wall; no reservations; April to mid October
what_to_order: Mixed grill platter|Grilled squid|Tuna steak|Tiger prawns
verdict: Simple grilled meat and fish at fair prices with one of the better views inside the walls, which is why the line forms. Good for crew, useless for anyone who will not queue. It is a summer house only: shut now, so it drops out of any October-to-Easter plan.
caveat: Closed until Easter 2027; walk-in only, queue in season

name: Konoba Dubrava
address: Bosanka 5, 20207 Dubrovnik (10 min by car above Old Town)
tier: UNDER THE BELL — THE COUNTRY KONOBAS
recognition: Lamb, veal and octopus peka under the bell; order 3–4 hours ahead
what_to_order: Lamb peka|Veal peka|Octopus peka|Sour cherry strudel
reservation: Call ahead; book table and peka together, 2–3 days ahead in season
notes: Lamb peka, ordered by phone hours ahead
verdict: The easiest proper peka from a Dubrovnik berth, and worth the planning. Book the table and the bell together, a day ahead if you can. The rest of the menu is ordinary; the peka is why you go. We found no 2026-dated evidence of trading or winter hours, and the phone number differs between sources, so confirm before sending guests up the hill.
caveat: Peka needs 3–4 h notice; 2026 trading and winter hours not confirmed; phone numbers conflict
hot_this_month: Peka weather: order the lamb or octopus peka by 11:00 for lunch, before the early November sunset over Lokrum (checked 22 Oct 2026).

name: Konoba Konavoski Dvori
address: Ljuta bb, 20210 Cavtat (Konavle, 35 min south of Dubrovnik)
tier: UNDER THE BELL — THE COUNTRY KONOBAS
recognition: Restored watermill on the Ljuta river in Konavle; staff in Konavle costume
what_to_order: Žaba na brodet|River trout|Lamb peka|Wild asparagus
reservation: Book about a week ahead for weekend lunch
notes: Žaba na brodet, frogs stewed the Konavle way
verdict: A lunch outing rather than a dinner, best combined with a drive through Konavle or a day at Cavtat. The costumes lean towards folklore, but the frog brodet and the trout are real local food you will not find in town. We found no 2026-dated evidence and no current MICHELIN listing, so confirm hours by phone, especially in winter.
caveat: Winter hours and 2026 trading not confirmed; 35 minutes' drive from Dubrovnik
hot_this_month: A Sunday lunch after the last Čilipi folklore shows of the season; frog brodet and trout by the Ljuta, booked a week ahead for weekends (checked 22 Oct 2026).

name: Bota Šare Mali Ston
address: Mali Ston bb, 20230 Ston (15th-c. salt warehouse)
tier: MALI STON — THE OYSTERS AT THE SOURCE
recognition: Mali Ston oysters served a few metres from the beds; Gault&Millau Croatia 2026 reviews the family business; Falstaff 2025: 85 points
what_to_order: Mali Ston oysters|Oyster tempura|Mussels na buzaru|Prawn pasta|Pošip
reservation: Walk-in usually possible at lunch; book dinner in summer
notes: A dozen Mali Ston oysters, raw with lemon
verdict: The more polished of the two Mali Ston houses, and the safer pick for guests: vaulted room, sea view, oysters opened to order a few metres from the beds. The sushi side is a modern addition rather than a local tradition; stay with the oysters and shellfish. Listings say it trades all year, which makes it one of the few out-of-town tables to plan in November.
caveat: Year-round opening is from an older Time Out listing; call to confirm winter hours
hot_this_month: Inside the oyster season again: the season runs about September to April (peak is March); lunch walk-in is possible, but phone ahead in winter (checked 22 Oct 2026).

name: Vila Koruna
tier: MALI STON — THE OYSTERS AT THE SOURCE
recognition: Family oyster house on Mali Ston bay since 1973; seawater tanks on the terrace; six rooms
what_to_order: Oysters raw|Baked or fried oysters|Mussels na buzaru|Grilled scampi
reservation: Walk-in usually fine outside high summer (old record); call ahead off-season
notes: Oysters raw from the terrace tanks, then mussels na buzaru
verdict: The plainer, older-feeling of the two Mali Ston houses, good for oysters, mussels and a long lunch by the water without ceremony. Fine for a Pelješac overnight. We found no 2026-dated evidence that it is trading and no winter hours, so this one needs a phone call before it goes on any guest list.
caveat: 2026 trading and winter hours not confirmed; call first
hot_this_month: Its off-season shape: lunch, oysters au naturel and mussels na buzaru, walk-in fine now the summer is over; pair it with a walk over the Ston walls (checked 22 Oct 2026).

name: Taj Mahal (Bosnian grill)
tier: WHERE THE CITY EATS WHEN THE OLD TOWN IS FULL
recognition: MICHELIN Bib Gourmand, Dubrovnik, listed in the Croatia selection; a 2026 Croatia list notes two consecutive Bibs
what_to_order: Taj Mahal special|Peppers stuffed with kajmak|Ćevapi in lepinja|Plum baklava
notes: The Taj Mahal special: veal with mushrooms in a crisp pastry shell.
verdict: Good-value Balkan cooking with a guide's backing, in a part of town where value is rare. Expect meat, kajmak and bread in quantity, not seafood. Book: the small room fills, and MICHELIN itself advises reservations. A sound last-minute table for crew or guests who are tired of grilled fish.
caveat: Small and popular, book ahead; winter hours not confirmed, call +385 20 323 221.

name: Pizzeria Tabasco
tier: WHERE THE CITY EATS WHEN THE OLD TOWN IS FULL
recognition: In Your Pocket: local and tourist opinion rates it the best pizza in Dubrovnik; Time Out 3/5
price_range: Below Old Town prices per In Your Pocket; no 2026 menu prices found (seen Oct 2026)
notes: A wood-fired pizza, or the oversized panzerotto.
verdict: A plain, honest pizzeria, not a destination: Time Out gives it three stars out of five and calls it standard, and that is fair. Its value is being open late, every day, a short walk from the walls, at prices well under the Stradun. Send crew here after service, or guests who want pizza without a scene.
caveat: No 2026-dated evidence found; hours and phone vary across listings, call ahead.

name: D'vino Wine Bar
tier: THE GLASS — A WINE BAR AND TWO PELJEŠAC CELLARS
recognition: Own site: over 60 wines by the glass, the largest selection in Dubrovnik (self-description); Time Out says 100+ wines stocked
what_to_order: Croatian red flight|Croatian white flight|Wine by the glass
notes: A flight of Croatian reds built around Plavac Mali.
verdict: The most efficient way to learn Pelješac, Korčula and Konavle wine in one sitting before the dinners and cellar visits. It is a bar, small plates at most, and tourist-facing by design, so it runs on the season. Check it is still open before building a late-October aperitivo around it.
caveat: Seasonal per Total Croatia News (about April–late October); may already be closed for winter, call first.
hot_this_month: A Plavac Mali flight from Pelješac in the week of Martinje, 11 November, when the country toasts the young wine (checked 22 Oct 2026).

name: Grgić Vina (cellar door)
tier: THE GLASS — A WINE BAR AND TWO PELJEŠAC CELLARS
recognition: Falstaff (Peter Moser, 17 Apr 2026): Plavac Mali 2022 93 pts, Pošip 2024 93 pts; listed in Falstaff 2026
price_range: Tasting fee covers both wines; no 2026 price found (seen Oct 2026)
reservation: Call or email ahead, especially off-season
notes: The Plavac Mali next to the Pošip.
verdict: A short, focused visit rather than a long estate tour: two glasses, a view over the Trstenik bay and a story every wine-minded guest will know. Pair it with lunch on Pelješac. Outside July and August the family-run schedule can slip, and nobody may be free to guide you; ring first.
caveat: Call ahead outside peak season; Time Out gives April–November only.
hot_this_month: After the harvest, by appointment only: email a week ahead for a tasting of the Plavac Mali and Pošip around Martinje (checked 22 Oct 2026).

name: Miloš Stagnum
tier: THE GLASS — A WINE BAR AND TWO PELJEŠAC CELLARS
recognition: Falstaff (Peter Moser, 17 Apr 2026): Miloš Stagnum 2016, 94 pts
verdict: The serious red stop on Pelješac, for guests who want to taste aged Plavac Mali rather than the fresh style. Tastings are quiet and unhurried. Fit it on the way back from Ston oysters; book in advance, since this is a family house, not a visitor centre.
caveat: Book ahead; listed hours are undated and 2026 tasting prices were not found.

name: Gruž Market (Tržnica Gruž)
tier: LA RUE — THE MARKET, THE SANDWICH, THE OCTOPUS BURGER
recognition: Time Out: arrive by 07:00 for the best fish from the Elafiti islands
notes: The morning's fish from the Elafiti boats.
verdict: The provisioning stop for any boat lying in Gruž: real fish, real vegetables, cash in hand. Go early, because the fish hall thins out fast. Do not expect a food hall; it is a market for buying, not for eating.
caveat: Cash only on most stalls; come before 07:00 for fish; hours conflict across listings.
hot_this_month: Provision early: the boats land about 06:30 and the fish is gone by 10:00; plan around the holidays of 1 and 18 November (checked 22 Oct 2026).

name: Buffet Škola
tier: THE BERTHS · LA RUE — THE MARKET, THE SANDWICH, THE OCTOPUS BURGER
recognition: Listed in Gault&Millau Croatia 2026 and Falstaff 2026 street food (82 pts)
what_to_order: Pršut and cheese sandwich|House bread|Glass of domestic red
reservation: Walk-in; eat in or take away
notes: The pršut and Konavle cheese sandwich on warm house bread.
verdict: The best cheap lunch inside the walls and the quickest: order, eat standing or take it to the harbour. It is not a restaurant and does not pretend to be. Good for crew between jobs and for guests who want one honest local bite between the walls walk and the boat.
caveat: Three tables only; hours and phone vary across listings.

name: Barba
tier: LA RUE — THE MARKET, THE SANDWICH, THE OCTOPUS BURGER
recognition: Time Out 4/5; Wanderlog list (Nov 2025) of top Dubrovnik street food
what_to_order: Octopus burger|Anchovy sandwich|Fried calamari|Octopus sandwich with mascarpone|Shrimp tacos
price_range: Octopus burger about EUR 8 (blogger, undated); shrimp burger EUR 14 (2024 review) (seen Oct 2026)
verdict: Worth one visit for the octopus burger, which most reviewers praise; past that the record is mixed, with complaints of heavy batter and a poor shrimp burger. Fast, cheap by Old Town standards, crowded at peak. Go off-hours and keep it to the octopus.
caveat: No 2026-dated evidence; hours conflict and winter opening unknown; call +385 91 205 3488.
